checks.description: Actual ASCII and binary STL parsing measures an asymmetric box; inches are converted exactly once and original bytes stay unchanged.
The real preparation reads declared technology and useful dimensions; demo slot values cannot establish compatibility.
A stored asset ID alone is not a measured file; source evidence must match project, piece, revision, asset and unit exactly.
Nonfinite or malformed measurements cannot generate candidates; valid measured dimensions are compared without silently rewriting stored dimensions.
Six orthogonal placements compare the measured box to the useful volume; exact contact is a raw fit and dimensional overflow stays visible.
The viewport uses actual Three matrices with determinant +1; all six placements of off-origin STL vertices agree with machine-axis dimensions in millimetres and inches.
Flat STL geometry is inspectable without a volumetric fit; an open 3D mesh never becomes physically qualified through its bounding box.
A report export retains its exact project and selection, rejects foreign identifiers, and cannot mutate state or claim a machine command.
The workbench reads authentic local STL bytes through an asynchronous inspector, shows their hash and unit, and routes orientation, machine, import and export controls.
Missing or invalid binaries show no substitute model; valid measurements and export remain available when WebGL cannot start.
A delayed STL preview always receives the currently selected machine volume, including a registry change during the read.
Changing the selected piece ignores an old asynchronous read; closing the workbench prevents a late viewport or STL from reappearing.
The open preparation retains its target after another screen selects a project; an asynchronous export receives an immutable snapshot of that target.
The live application associates a real STL with its captured piece in inches after the active project changes, preserves its name and technology, and exports the inspected target.
Changing a piece while its replacement STL is being read or stored preserves the current file and geometry instead of overwriting them with the late import.
A general multi-file import keeps its original project without selecting or showing a foreign piece after another screen switches projects.
The workbench stylesheet parses, honors reduced motion, and renders user-supplied project, piece and machine names without executable markup.

reason: Real STL parsing, pure Three geometry and isolated JSDOM only. No browser preview server or physical command.
